thesisQuality.note: Realized High-NA production use, strong 2025 backlog and accelerating 2026 AI-linked customer commitments directly corroborate the leading-edge lithography thesis.

financialOperatingMomentum.note: Q2 sales EUR9.326B, 54.0% gross margin and EUR2.918B net income followed 2025 sales growth to EUR32.667B and management raised 2026 guidance to EUR43-45B.

marketValuationOpportunity.note: A roughly $625B market cap, 51.53x trailing P/E and 29.04x forward P/E embed substantial execution expectations despite strong growth.

catalystScore.note: Raised 2026 guidance, strong customer commitments, planned EUV capacity expansion and High-NA production qualification create identifiable conversion catalysts.

governancePower.note: Large profitability, EUR7.582B quarter-end liquidity and ongoing shareholder returns support execution capacity; no current governance defect is evidenced in this packet.

alignment2036.note: Leading-edge EUV/High-NA lithography is foundational equipment for advanced logic and memory scaling tied directly to AI compute growth.

crossDivisionLeverage.note: EUV, DUV, metrology/inspection and installed-base service/upgrade revenue reinforce one another across semiconductor production generations.

bottleneckControl.note: ASML remains the unique commercial supplier of leading-edge EUV lithography, with High-NA moving into production use.

scenarioRobustness.note: Logic, memory, installed-base service and multiple lithography generations diversify demand, while export controls and semiconductor capex cyclicality remain material external scenarios.

substitutionResilience.note: No current commercial peer displaces ASML at leading-edge EUV; customer process alternatives exist but High-NA production qualification strengthens technical lock-in.

supplyChainResilience.note: Strong liquidity and profitability provide financial resilience, but extreme system complexity and specialized supplier capacity remain meaningful throughput dependencies.

pricingPower.note: Unique leading-edge lithography capability, strong commitments and sustained >50% gross margin support exceptional value capture, though exact system-level margins are undisclosed.

risk1.note: Principal risks are export-control/geopolitical market access, customer capex cyclicality, specialized supplier throughput, High-NA economics/adoption timing and a demanding valuation baseline.

confidence.note: Current issuer financial results and technology-production evidence anchor operating and bottleneck claims; independent S&P/Nasdaq-derived market data anchors valuation. Exact future unit mix and cancellation economics remain explicit non-gating unknowns.

thesis: ASML controls the critical leading-edge lithography bottleneck required for continued advanced logic and memory scaling, with High-NA production evidence and AI-linked customer commitments strengthening the long-duration thesis.
keyRisk: Export-control/geopolitical restrictions and a demanding valuation can impair realized returns even if technological dominance persists.
nextCatalyst: Q3 2026 results and subsequent evidence on EUV/High-NA bookings, capacity conversion and customer acceptance.
